title: Per-Tenant RPM and TPM Rate Limiter
signature: class TenantRateLimiter: __init__(self, limits, clock, max_wait=0.0), acquire(self, tenant, tokens) -> float, settle(self, tenant, reserved, actual)
hints: Keep two buckets per tenant: requests (capacity rpm, refill rpm/60 per second) and tokens (capacity tpm, refill tpm/60 per second). Refill lazily from the time you last touched them, and never above capacity.
The wait is the larger of the two waits: max(0, (need - level) / rate) for each bucket.
Decide before you deduct. A rejected request must leave both buckets exactly as they were, or a client hammering you with retries locks itself out for good.
An admitted request with a wait > 0 is a reservation: deduct now and let the level go negative. The refill pays the debt back, so the next caller queues behind it.
